transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because I’m having a really hard time keeping up with basic adult responsibilities. I keep forgetting things like paying bills, replying to interview emails, showing up for appointments, or finishing errands I said I’d do. It’s gotten to the point where it’s actually costing me opportunities, and I’m worried I can’t just keep brushing it off.
Did you have these kinds of problems with forgetting things or staying organized when you were a child?

Yes. Even in elementary school, it was showing up. Teachers would say I was bright, but I was always losing worksheets or not being able to find assignments because my desk was such a mess. I also remember rushing through directions and talking out of turn a lot. It wasn’t just a recent thing.
Do you often have trouble staying focused on a task, even when you want to get it done?

Yes, all the time. I’ll sit down to do something I really need to do, like update my resume or work on a coding practice problem, and then one text notification or someone talking outside will pull me away. Sometimes it’s not even something external—it’ll just be a random thought about another task, and before I realize it, I’m completely off track.
Do you often lose focus partway through tasks or conversations, even when you’re trying to pay attention?

Yes. I’ll lose track even when I’m trying to listen or finish something. Like if I’m updating my resume or doing a coding practice problem, one text notification or someone talking outside can pull me away completely. Sometimes it’s just a random thought about another task, and then I realize I haven’t been paying attention at all.
Do you often act or speak before thinking?

Yes, I do. In conversations, or even in interviews, I’ll jump in before the other person is finished because I think I know what they’re going to ask. Then sometimes I realize I answered the wrong thing, or I cut them off. It happens a lot, and it’s embarrassing.
Do these problems with attention and organization happen in more than one part of your life, such as at work, at home, or in relationships?

Yes, it’s in more than one area. Since I got fired, I’ve missed follow-ups after interviews, which obviously affects work. And I also had to step back from a volunteer project I really cared about because I couldn’t keep up with the basic organizing and follow-through. It feels like I can’t reliably manage the steps I need to move my life forward right now.
Do you have repetitive checking or rituals that you feel driven to do, even when you know they don’t really make sense?
Not really, no. I don’t think I have rituals like that. I might double-check something once in a normal way, but I don’t feel driven to keep checking over and over or do things in a specific ritual.
When you have trouble focusing or following through, is it usually because you’re worrying a lot?

I’m not really sure. I mean, I do worry sometimes, but I haven’t noticed that as the main reason I lose focus or don’t follow through. It just kind of happens, even when I’m not especially anxious about anything.
Do you feel down or depressed most days?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I feel depressed most days, but I can feel pretty discouraged sometimes. It’s not something I’ve been tracking closely.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge, even when there isn’t a specific reason?
I’m not really sure. I do get anxious sometimes, but I haven’t noticed feeling on edge all the time for no clear reason.
Have you felt sad or down most days for the past two years?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve felt sad or down most days for that long, but I haven’t kept track of it closely.
Do you often find yourself worrying about many different things?
I’m not sure. I do worry about things sometimes, but I don’t know if it’s many different things or more than most people.
Do you find it hard to control your worrying once it starts?
I’m not really sure. Sometimes once I start worrying it can stick around for a bit, but I don’t know if I’d say it’s hard to control exactly.
Have these attention and organization problems caused significant problems in your work, school, or daily life?

Yes. It’s caused pretty big problems. Since I got fired, I’ve missed follow-ups for interviews, and I had to step back from a volunteer project I really cared about. So I’m unemployed right now, and it feels like I can’t reliably manage even the basic steps to move my life forward.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t think so. I’ve had some low moments, but I wouldn’t say I’ve felt down or hopeless most of the day nearly every day.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying on most days?
I’m not sure. I do worry sometimes, but I haven’t really tracked whether it’s most days or how much time it takes up.
Do you feel worried or anxious more days than not?
I’m not really sure. I do get anxious sometimes, but I don’t know if it’s more days than not. I haven’t been keeping track that closely.
Do you often feel restless or unable to relax?

Yes. I feel restless a lot, especially if I have to sit through something like an interview, a meeting, or even a movie. It’s like this pressure in my body where I need to get up, move around, shift in my seat, or do something with my hands, otherwise I feel like I’m going to crawl out of my skin.
Do you find yourself worrying on most days about a lot of different things?
I don’t really know. I worry about things sometimes, but I can’t say it’s most days or a lot of different things. I haven’t paid close enough attention to be sure.
Do you often feel physically restless even when you are not feeling worried or anxious?

Yes. It can happen even when I’m not really worried about anything. Like if I have to sit through an interview, a meeting, or even a movie, I get this pressure in my body where I need to move, shift around, or do something with my hands. If I don’t, I feel like I’m going to crawl out of my skin.
